scope: replace the 61-pose basic animation source while preserving its historical approval and excluding it from new visual generation

previous_source.historical_reviews_and_conversion_diagno: Retained at their canonical doc/ and out/diagnostics/ paths, indexed by archive_manifest.json with hashes; they are records of the previous source, not active visual references.

preflight_blockers: 1254x1254 raster does not divide into the intended exact 8x8 cell grid.
741833 pixels have partial alpha; hard cutout was not produced.
Visible cyan/blue fringe is present around silhouettes.
208338 visible RGB values exceed any limited pixel-art/runtime palette.
Exact frame extraction, frame order, pose uniqueness, and object attachment remain unverified.

learning: Archival must preserve the source, its approval declaration, metadata/lineage, and a hash-indexed map of associated immutable reviews and diagnostics.
A replacement's lineage must name the approved model sheet as its only visual parent; GDD/TDD are written constraints, not visual references.
A generated image is not promotable because it resembles a sprite atlas: alpha, silhouette fringe, exact cell geometry, palette, and frame semantics must pass before conversion.
Keep the replacement explicitly blocked and unapproved when preflight fails; do not convert it or describe it as a production-ready sprite sheet.
claim_ceiling: source organization verified; replacement remains a blocked candidate, with no conversion or ROM claim
